description: For every nonempty structure \(M\), parameter set \(A\), sequence of pairwise distinct tuples of fixed positive finite length, and infinite linear order \(I\), there are a nonempty elementary extension through an embedding \(f:M\to N\) and pairwise distinct tuples indexed by \(I\), order-indiscernible over \(f[A]\) and locally based on the source through this same embedding.
